purpose: Image asset inventory for the Space Adventure Captain guided story wizard.

art_direction.style: premium children storybook, cinematic space adventure, soft 3D illustration, high contrast, cheerful, safe, magical
art_direction.palette: deep navy, cosmic purple, electric blue, warm yellow, emerald green, coral red
art_direction.lighting: soft glow, rim light, star sparkle highlights
art_direction.text_policy: Do not bake labels or readable UI text into generated images. Flutter renders all labels and prompts.
art_direction.character_consistency: Captain Nova is a warm childlike astronaut guide with a round helmet, star headphones, blue-gold suit accents, and a friendly expression.
art_direction.safety: No weapons, no frightening aliens, no realistic danger, no sharp horror elements.

rendering_notes.choice_labels: Rendered by Flutter below each icon.
rendering_notes.choice_cards: Card/glow/ring can be rendered by Flutter where possible; image assets should be transparent icons.
rendering_notes.selected_state: Prefer Flutter glow/scale animation plus one reusable sparkle overlay.
rendering_notes.randomization: Server sends 3 to 5 choices per step from the full pool.
rendering_notes.accessibility: Every choice has a short label that can be read aloud.

flow_steps.title: Meet Captain Nova
flow_steps.goal: Introduce the wizard and explain that the child will help create a space story.

flow_steps.title: Pick Hero
flow_steps.goal: Choose the main hero of the story.

flow_steps.title: Choose Mission
flow_steps.goal: Choose the gentle story problem to solve.

flow_steps.title: Magic Moment
flow_steps.goal: Choose a special object or magical help.

flow_steps.title: Story Feeling
flow_steps.goal: Choose the emotional flavor of the story.

flow_steps.title: Story Length
flow_steps.goal: Choose short, long, or very long story.

flow_steps.title: Building Story
flow_steps.goal: Keep the child engaged while the final story is generated.

flow_steps.title: Story Complete
flow_steps.goal: Present the completed story and start narration.
